evidence: A zoning of the design climate, not a model of vegetation: each T21 land cell (about 170 km across at the equator) takes the biome its aridity class gives it, with its warmth, night light and settings beside it. The aridity is the GCM's ten-year rain over a Priestley-Taylor demand without wind or humidity; the classes are UNEP's, the humid class divided at aridity 1, and each takes the standard name of the broad biome the Millennium Ecosystem Assessment gives the class on Earth. The biomes are classed by climate alone; which organisms each holds is a later design question. The gap's scale of 0.83 is a sensitivity of the classes from three CM1 boxes, never a bias-corrected climate. The lakes and tides come from geography's products, the lakes on an older climate run; the night light from the living-light grid in the mean geometry under a clear sky. Provisional while the GCM-CM1 gap stands: the map is remade if the convection work changes the design climate.
reading_rule: cells holds one entry per GCM land cell (land_binary_mask > 0.5) of the run, in columns: lat and lon (degrees, east) are the T21 cell centres; weight is the cell's share of the land by cos(lat), as the design readings weight it; area_km2 the cell's box area. aridity is rain over demand (mm/yr, 365-day years) from the ten-year means; aridity_spans the five two-year spans; aridity_se the ten-year mean's standard error from them; aridity_store the store runs', in store_runs order. biome indexes biomes (0 hyper-arid desert to 5 wet forest) as run; biome_gap at the rain times gap.scale; biome_band_low and _high at the combined band's ends, gap.scale times (aridity - 2 se) and aridity + 2 se. robust is true where the biome holds across that band, robust_gap and robust_years for each source alone, robust_store on all three store runs, robust_all both. margin_down and margin_up are how far the rain must fall or rise, as a fraction, to leave the class (99 where no bound). class_kept_in_resamples is the share of the bootstrap's resamples of the years that keep the cell's class; beside_sea marks land cells with a GCM water cell among their eight neighbours. night_regime indexes night_regimes; tide_class indexes tide_classes (-1 no coast); shares are of the land.

biomes.name: wet forest
biomes.evidence: published relation (aridity 1, where the rain meets the demand; MA 2005)

gap.note: The rain scaled uniformly toward CM1's ratio at the three gap boxes is a sensitivity of the classes, never a bias-corrected climate; three boxes do not give the gap's pattern.

grid.note: T21 Gaussian rows north to south; row edges are midpoints between rows; cells index row and col

land.resolution: T21: 64 by 32 cells, 5.625 deg of longitude (170.6 km at the equator) by about 5.5 deg of latitude (about 168 km)

bootstrap.note: years drawn with replacement from the run's years, each resample composited as the full record; shares' spread is the sampling spread of a mean over this many years

earth_drylands.source: Safriel & Adeel (2005), Millennium Ecosystem Assessment, Dryland Systems, table 22.1

shores.note: Coast length counts the 4 px/deg land-sea pixel edges in each land cell, so it depends on that resolution; the belts take the flat shores' 0.6-2.5 km on every shore, an upper-end screen.

soda_lakes.note: Closed rain-fed lakes are the drainage product's non-spilling lakes, on the older climate run A28_dim5_moon years 20-29; the sea-level lakes are the atlas's small closed depressions below the seas' level. Where they stand in dry cells they are the soda lakes' candidates.

hyper-arid.soils: Leptosols, Regosols under a rock-fragment pavement; Calcisols where water gathers
hyper-arid.kept_by: the pavement left whole; traffic on set ways

arid.soils: Calcisols, Arenosols of feldspar-and-glass sand, Durisols
arid.kept_by: a biological crust over the open ground; disturbed patches reseeded; grazers steered off

semi-arid.soils: Calcisols, Kastanozems, Vertisols on mare remnants and in hollows
semi-arid.kept_by: plants and litter over about 35-60% of the ground, crusts between; hollows as planting pits; rotated grazing

dry sub-humid.kept_by: a nearly closed perennial cover of about 50-80% with litter; managed disturbance in place of fire

humid.soils: Andosol-like young soils, Cambisols, Nitisols on basalt, aging towards Lixisols and Acrisols; Gleysols, Histosols, Fluvisols on wet ground
humid.kept_by: forest and wetland cover; nutrient return by the project's loops; conservation farming
humid.ease: easy to hold, sustained effort for fertility

storm_water_surfaces.source: the storm-water study on domain/hydrosphere, as the soils study tabulates it (section 3.3)

night_humidity.note: Relative humidity of the 3-day mean state at the lowest level, nights (|hour angle| > 90 deg) averaged; dew needs about 0.9 (coast-water study).
